name: Calcium-channel discovery run
description: Search, analyse and score unclassified candidates against the whole catalogue. The scorer's evidence gate (D3) and sister-family test (D14) both matter more here than in a single-family project: the sister panel is derived from the hazard registry and therefore contains the sodium channels, the Ca2+-activated potassium channels, the pumps and the EF-hand sensors, which is exactly the set a naive scorer promotes.
